name: Amazon Ridgeland

timeline.event: Buildings 1-4 are operational, based on the buildings shells and backup generators and most of the landscaping looking complete. Building 5 roof is complete but still lacks cooling equipment.

Buildings 6-14 are operational (estimate). Buildings 1-4 took an estimated 2.25 years on this site. We assume Buildings 6-14 get underway by July 2026, and take the same time as Buildings 1-4. This is later than the expected completion by…

sources.publisher: Epoch AI, Frontier Data Centers Hub (CC-BY)
sources.quote: Amazon Ridgeland: current power 228 MW; owner Amazon.

explain: Amazon Ridgeland is an operating AI data center in Ridgeland, MS, owned by amazon. Epoch AI estimates it draws 228 MW today and 1,008 MW when finished.
